title:
A Data Flow Event (DFE) is a typed-based way of tagging a time series with enough information
so that it can be aggregated and properly matched between the input and output of analytics,
especially when functioning as transforms.

 A DataFlowEvent must be declared with {@ Ann.DFE} annotation to specify the time nature of data to be generated.
